_note: Source of truth for the Google Ads account (788-067-9748). Rebuilt 2026-09-18 after the riggers-first revamp: the old single 'Search - Rigging & Heavy Haul - Leads' campaign was removed with heavy haul. Four campaigns, one per service theme, each with its own daily budget so spend cannot drift between themes (under Maximize clicks you CANNOT reallocate between ad groups inside one campaign — that lesson cost two months of heavy-haul spend). ads/review.md is the weekly routine that reads this file.

sharedSettings.network: Search only — Display OFF, Search Partners OFF
sharedSettings.bidding: Maximize clicks with a max CPC cap
sharedSettings.schedule: Mon-Fri 06:00-20:00, Sat 08:00-16:00, Sun off (account TZ = ET)

descriptions: Dispatch built for fleets of four trucks and up. We do not take on owner-operators.

Tell us your fleet size, equipment and home base. We'll show you what we can keep moving.

sharedNegatives._note: Applied at every campaign via a shared negative keyword list named 'BL - Global Negatives'. Carried over from the old account's 66 tested negatives plus the new ones the 2026-09-18 autocomplete research surfaced.

neverAdd.free: Blocks 'free quote' and 'free estimate', which are high-intent. Tested and rejected twice on the old account.
neverAdd.ontario: Ontario, California is a major Inland Empire freight hub. Blocking it loses real US shippers.
neverAdd.oilfield: Only ever the phrase "oilfield trucking" — bare 'oilfield' blocks legitimate oilfield rig and equipment rigging work.
neverAdd.badass logistics: Own brand. CTR is roughly 3x campaign average and it feeds Ad Rank. Worth the couple of dollars.

rules: No prices, no rate claims, no MC or DOT numbers, never 'our trucks' or 'our fleet' — the company is not a motor carrier.
No certification claims (OSHA, NCCCO, ASME) unless the company actually holds them.
Freight between sites is always 'through our licensed broker and carrier partners'.
Heavy haul is retired. No trailer-type keywords (RGN, lowboy, step deck, conestoga, double drop), no oversize or permit keywords.
Dispatch never targets owner-operators or new authority.
Stay on Maximize clicks until a campaign has 15+ conversions in 30 days, then consider Maximize conversions for that campaign only.
